completed_changes: Extracted legacy AppStore payload mapping into a pure component
Preserved guest/licensed lock semantics and appstore/appstore_v2 wrappers
Fixed dylib missing-card null access and homepage child-category N+1 queries
Centralized Category type display and write normalization
Made Monitor blacklist move and Kami generation transactional
Added SourceConfigRepository with shared 60-second cache and invalidation after Config writes/deletes
Extended CI to PHP 7.0, 8.2 and 8.4
Added BaoTa deployment contract checks for BT_DB_* database placeholders
Phase 4 real BaoTa one-click install was reported successful after database placeholder packaging fix
Fixed blacklist false-success caused by NOT NULL usetime/endtime columns being omitted from INSERT
Centralized blacklist insert/lifetime semantics in BlacklistPolicy
Black admin list now exposes addtime/usetime/endtime; endtime=0 means permanent and usetime=0 means not yet hit
Black add/edit forms support optional expiration; blank expiration persists as permanent
Monitor-to-blacklist and automatic trace blacklist paths now write complete fa_black rows
AppStore and dylib blacklist checks ignore expired rows and record first blacklist hit time
Added root nginx.rewrite for BaoTa automatic ThinkPHP pseudo-static import
Added blacklist policy, persistence-contract and nginx deployment regression coverage
Phase 5 real deployment and blacklist behavior were user-verified OK
Extracted legacy 添加者/破解者 trace parsing and 25/40-character gate into TraceMonitorPolicy
Clarified monitor UI labels from generic abnormal-request wording to source-identity/source-record wording
Added a reusable terminal trace-monitor probe script
Added trace monitor policy and integration regression tests
Phase 6 release seed policy removes historical 2022 fa_monitor observations from fresh BaoTa packages
Phase 7 changes Category admin from full-list client rendering to true server-side pagination
Phase 7 defaults to 1000 rows per page with 200/500/1000 page-size choices
Phase 7 quick search now runs against the full database by application name instead of only in-memory loaded rows
Phase 7 type tabs are filtered by the server and reset to page 1
Phase 7 hides software description, remark, app icon and weigh columns by default while keeping the column chooser
Phase 7 index requests no longer build the full category Tree; parentList construction is deferred to add/edit
Phase 7 Category list query sends only the fields required by the table/column chooser

performance_findings.conclusion: Existing opencry whole-payload external encryption is the dominant public /appstore latency; protocol/encryption behavior is intentionally unchanged in Phase 7.

intentionally_preserved_risks: Category list-page daily reset still writes cs/cstime using day-of-month
App-mb.php and Index2.php remain in runtime paths pending production access-log verification
Kami keeps legacy MD5/time/rand generation semantics
Duplicate blacklist rows remain allowed for compatibility
Trace identities are labels supplied by client payload position; the server does not independently prove adder/cracker identity
appstore/appstore_v2 encryption remains whole-payload and depends on the existing external encryption service
next_task: Deploy the Phase 7 BaoTa package to a disposable/real-compatible site and verify Category admin: first page returns 1000 rows, page navigation works, quick search covers the whole dataset, type tabs reset to page 1, hidden columns can be re-enabled, add/edit/delete/batch actions still work, and browser memory is materially lower than the old full-list rendering.
